maddeler.e:
أتشاءم (form VI)
# أَتَشَاءَمُ (ʔatašāʔamu) /ʔa.ta.ʃaː.ʔa.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَشَاءَمَ (tašāʔama)
# أَتَشَاءَمَ (ʔatašāʔama) /ʔa.ta.ʃaː.ʔa.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَشَاءَمَ (tašāʔama)
# أَتَشَاءَمْ (ʔatašāʔam) /ʔa.ta.ʃaː.ʔam/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَشَاءَمَ (tašāʔama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
